Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: August invoice attempt failed (help)

Hi Simon — thanks for flagging this.

Short summary: Stripe returned a cluster of soft-declines (issuer 3DS required / temporary AVS mismatch). We attempted automated retries over 72 hours but saw repeated failures on the same card fingerprint. We then routed the subscription through our secondary PSP (PSP-B) for one of the attempts; that cleared in a subset of cases but not all.

Next steps I propose:
- Immediate: We can issue a one-off hosted payment link for customers to update card (merchant-initiated update flow).
- Short term: Enable subscription-router fallback for Railroad.ai so that future authorization attempts rotate across PSPs earlier in the retry window.
- Tax/VAT: If you need a debit note or amended VAT line for Aug, confirm the entity (US vs EU billing) and we will reissue.

Ben — can you confirm whether we did a forced re-auth via PSP-B on 2027-08-30 (I have logs but want your confirmation)?

Simon — I'll add a concise customer-facing email draft below we can send with the hosted link.

Neha
Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0123

Confirming: we sent a manual re-route on 2027-08-30 at 03:22 UTC from PSP-A -> PSP-B for merchant ref RAIL-4721-03. PSP-B returned an 'authorization_succeeded' for one charge and 'card_not_supported' for another (same fingerprint).

I've attached the retry matrix — psps, attempt timestamps, response codes. Suggestion: flip subscription-router to attempt PSP-B on first retry instead of third attempt for this customer (high MRR). Also recommend a one-off outreach from AE to ask customer to update their card (higher conversion).

Neha / Ben — thanks. A few clarifying Qs from our side:
1) If we send customers a hosted link, will Redwood record that as a merchant-initiated update so we don't trigger SCA again?
2) For the seats that were suspended, can you provide a line item we can send to our customers to explain the access drop (we need a short, non-technical note).
3) On VAT: Railroad.ai is UK-registered but they operate under a US billing entity for this contract; please mark the invoices as reverse-charge not applicable and we'll accept a debit note if needed.

Simon
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Harris <simon@railroad.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 12:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: August invoice attempt failed (help)

Answers below:
1) Hosted payment link is designed as a card update (merchant-initiated) and will not require SCA in most flows; we’ll explicitly surface that guidance in the email. If the issuer insists on SCA, it's out of our control — we'll capture the 3DS flow when it happens.
2) Short line item for customers: “Access to seats temporarily suspended due to a failed card authorization; seats will resume after payment method update.”
3) Understood on VAT; we'll reissue a debit note for bookkeeping that keeps the original invoice amounts and includes a note: "billing entity: US — reverse charge not applied".

Operational asks assigned:
- Ben: AE outreach to finance contact (email + phone) — target today EOD.
- Aditya: Toggle subscription-router fallback for Railroad.ai to prefer PSP-B on first retry — please confirm ETA.
- Marissa: Draft debit note, include the VAT note above; send to accounting@railroad.ai.

I'll coordinate the hosted link and monitor reattempts for the next 48 hours.

Neha
